evidence_against.relevance: Alex behaves warmly toward several group members and makes one-on-one plans with other friends, reducing the distinctiveness of the behavior toward Jordan.
There has been no explicit romantic framing, romantic physical contact, or statement of romantic interest.
Alex postponed Jordan's proposed dinner twice and did not offer a replacement date within the following two weeks, weakening the case for active special interest.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Alex initiated two one-on-one plans, which could indicate special interest but can also fit friendship.
Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing Jordan's preferred tea show personalized attention.
Repeated extended one-on-one texting after group events suggests sustained interest in interacting with Jordan.

recommended_action.explanation: The personalized attention and one-on-one contact are meaningful but remain compatible with Alex's broader friendliness; observing whether Alex follows up or distinguishes Jordan more clearly would provide better evidence.

uncertainty_explanation: Facts C1-F1 through C1-F3 support possible special interest, while C1-F4 through C1-F6 provide substantial friendship-consistent and non-escalatory evidence. Neither interpretation is sufficiently better supported on this record.
